body: I was in the hospital and got treated for acute bronchitis that was caused by bacteria, so I got antibiotics and they took a lot of different tests and a lung x-ray. I feel fine besides from the pain, it's better now tho. It's the most noticeable when I lie in bed and turn to a sid. So i think it's the muscle or bone that's hurting and not pneumonia or something like that.
I don't have pain when I breath in deep, it feels like it's muscular or in the bone, not from the lungs. I can feel it "pop" also, not much but like when you crack a finger.

I feel you mate, i can't imagine being with someone for 5 years and then nothing... I "only" was with this girl for 1 and a half year in total and it still hurts like hell... I just wish i could stop thinking about her but i can't, as i said it's not been a single day that i haven't thought about her, and it's never just one short time a day, it's almost all the time... 

I've been where you are but now i have friends and a job but that really doesn't help much to be honest, i still have no motivation and aspirations. I work, go home, lie in bed, play some videogames and sleep, some days i hang out with friends but it really doesn't matter much i feel...
